'''Verra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Reegas Vance]]. Verra served aboard Vance's [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Blackstar'']] and he accompanied the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] when it traveled to salvage a derelict ship in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. However, rival salvagers [[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] boarded the ''Blackstar'' and shot Verra in the chest with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.

==Behind the scenes==
Verra was created by the writer [[Paul S. Kemp]] and appeared in the short story ''[[A Fair Trade]]'', which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 129|129th edition]] of the magazine ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' in [[2011]].
